episodeTitle.en: How to build trust and grow as a product leader | Fareed Mosavat (Reforge, Slack, Instacart, Pixar)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何建立信任并成长为产品领导者 | 法里德·莫萨瓦特（Reforge、Slack、Instacart、Pixar）

guestBioOfficial.en: Fareed Mosavat is Chief Development Officer at Reforge, where he leads production, content, and new-product experiences. Previously, he led growth and product teams at Slack and Instacart, was a GM at Zynga, and also served as VP of Product at RunKeeper. Before all of that, Fareed’s fascinating career began in engineering for Pixar, where he learned the art of storytelling and collaboration. In today’s episode, we talk about how his time at Pixar influenced the way he thinks about product, why it’s so difficult to become a better PM, and how to avoid the “manager death spiral.” Fareed shares important insights on how to earn the trust of your manager and coworkers, the four types of product work—and why you need to understand all four. He also provides solid examples of how to generalize your learnings and explains why this will expand your options, make you a better PM, and boost your chances of moving into a leadership role.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 法里德·莫萨瓦特（Fareed Mosavat）是Reforge公司的首席开发官，负责产品、内容和新产品体验。此前，他曾在Slack和Instacart领导增长和产品团队，在Zynga担任总经理，并在RunKeeper担任产品副总裁。在此之前，法里德令人惊叹的职业生涯始于皮克斯动画工作室的工程师，在那里他学会了讲故事和协作的艺术。在本期节目中，我们探讨了他在皮克斯的经历如何影响他对产品的思考方式，为什么成为一名更优秀的产品经理如此困难，以及如何避免"管理者职业生涯的恶性循环"。法里德分享了如何赢得经理和同事信任的重要见解，以及四种产品工作类型——并解释为何需要理解这四种类型。他还提供了如何将所学知识推广应用的实例，并解释了这样做将如何拓展你的选择范围，助你成为更出色的产品经理，并增加晋升领导职位的机会。

title.en: How to build trust and grow as a product leader | Fareed Mosavat (Reforge, Slack, Instacart, Pixar)
title.zh: 如何建立信任并成长为产品领导者 | 法里德·莫萨瓦特（Reforge、Slack、Instacart、Pixar）

summary.en: Fareed argues that the only way to get better at product management is to do the real work—shipping real products for real customers with real data—because training, mentorship, and reading are merely layers on top of raw repetition. He walks through the difficult transition from individual contributor to manager, emphasizing that crossing 'the canyon' requires deliberately expanding your scope and owning outcomes rather than tasks. A core theme is creating opportunities to take on more responsibility: great PMs accelerate by seeking out the highest-leverage work and proving they can handle bigger bets. He also shares practical advice on how to build the reps that compound into senior product judgment, making this a field guide for any PM who wants to level up from solid executor to influential leader.
summary.zh: Fareed 认为，提升产品管理能力唯一的途径就是去做真正的工作——为真实的客户、用真实的数据去交付真实的产品——因为培训、导师指导和阅读都只是在大量重复练习之上的一层包装。他拆解了从一线执行者（IC）到管理者那段艰难的跨越，强调跨过这道“峡谷”需要刻意扩大自己的影响范围，并对结果而非任务负责。一个核心主题是创造机会去承担更多责任：优秀的 PM 会主动去寻找杠杆最高的事情，并证明自己能扛得起更大的赌注，从而加速成长。他还分享了如何通过一次次实战积累出高阶产品判断力的实用建议，对每一位想从靠谱执行者进阶为有影响力的领导者 PM 来说，这都是一份实战指南。
